programme.title: La frontière États-Unis-Mexique
programme.desc: La nouvelle voiture d'un homme d'affaires de Mexico sème le doute chez les agents, qui constatent qu'il ne voyage que rarement aux États-Unis ; sur le pont Juárez Lincoln, un individu est détenu après qu'un chien renifleur a détecté de la drogue.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Lorsque le vol El Al 1862 percute un édifice de 10 étages en banlieue d'Amsterdam, l'enquête révèle qu'un problème potentiellement mortel menace tous les 747 dans le ciel.

programme.title: Mayday

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Plus de 50 ans après un accident d'avion qui a tué le secrétaire de l'ONU, Dag Hammarskjöld, une commission spéciale lance une nouvelle enquête et dévoile le mystère entourant cet incident d'aviation controversé.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Le vol 670 d'Airways Atlantic fait la navette d'un groupe d'employés d'une compagnie pétrolière; un arrêt de routine sur une petite île norvégienne se transforme en un véritable cauchemar; plusieurs personnes meurent dans le brasier.

programme.title: Mayday

programme.title: The Manny
programme.desc: Morgan stalks his way into the lives of busy social media influencer Lani and her son, Jaylen, to become their male nanny; as Morgan shows himself to be someone who is too good to be true, he meddles with Lani and Jaylen's lives.

programme.title: Little jesus
programme.desc: Tells the story of Jean who pins his hopes of recovering from his wounds on a miracle: his ten-year-old son. He is convinced that Loulou is the new Messiah.

programme.title: Twisted Neighbor
programme.desc: A cookbook editor moves into a gossipy neighborhood whose residents are obsessed with an app. When one of the neighbors suddenly disappears, the group chat pinpoints her as the prime suspect.

programme.title: Marry Me
programme.desc: After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. As forces conspire to separate the unlikely newlyweds, they must soon decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Murder by Text
programme.desc: A concert rehearsal is stalled when the bass player dies from an apparent suicide. Jenn discovers that a stun gun was used to immobilize the victim before her death, but before Jenn can confront the weapon's owner, another band member is murdered.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
programme.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: In the 1980s New York City, Dog assembles Robot as a companion, and they become best buddies. On a Labor Day outing to Coney Island, Robot's metal parts rust, and he can't move.

programme.title: Paddington in Peru
programme.desc: Paddington and the Brown family stumble across a legendary treasure as they embark on a thrilling quest through the rainforests of the Amazon to find his beloved aunt.

programme.title: Mr. Monk's Last Case: A Monk Movie
programme.desc: Monk steps out of retirement as his stepdaughter's wedding turns tragic when her fiancé dies in a bungee jumping accident.

programme.title: In Cold Light
programme.desc: Fresh out of prison, young Ava tries to reclaim her drug empire but gets framed for murder instead. Hunted by cops and a ruthless crime boss, she must face her estranged father as she battles betrayal amid all the bloodshed.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Zach and Emmy's trip on a hot-air balloon takes a terrifying turn when they get hijacked by a passenger with a link to Zach's past. As the mystery of their relationship is revealed, their spectacular ride turns into a lethal battle high in the sky.

programme.title: The Amateur
programme.desc: Charlie Heller is a brilliant CIA decoder whose world comes crashing down when his wife dies in a London terrorist attack. When his supervisors refuse to take action, he embarks on a dangerous trek across the globe to track down those responsible.

programme.title: The Apprentice
programme.desc: A young Donald Trump, eager to make his name as the hungry second son of a wealthy family in the 1970s New York, comes under the spell of cutthroat lawyer Roy Cohn.

programme.title: Memoir of a Snail
programme.desc: After a series of misfortunes, a snail-collecting, melancholic misfit learns how to find confidence within herself amid the clutter of everyday life.

programme.title: Selena + Chef
programme.desc: Internationally acclaimed chef, restaurant owner, and author Marcus Samuelsson coaches Selena through cooking a dish.

programme.title: Freud's Last Session
programme.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programme.title: Shayda
programme.desc: A young Iranian mother takes refuge in an Australian women's shelter with her 6-year-old daughter during the two weeks of Nowruz, the Persian New Year. Her path to freedom is jeopardized when her estranged husband arrives.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Beach Murder
programme.desc: Jenn suspects foul play when the body of an avid surfer is found on an isolated beach, the victim of an apparent drowning.

programme.title: Killer Coworker
programme.desc: When a spa employee is framed for the murder of a jealous co-worker, she must uncover the culprit before she becomes the next victim.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Branded a traitor, an elite intelligence agent (Tom Cruise) investigates a failed Prague mission to retrieve a computer disk.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: During World War II, Lt. Gen. Leslie Groves Jr. appoints physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer to work on the top-secret Manhattan Project. Oppenheimer and a team of scientists spend years developing the atomic bomb, forever changing the course of history.

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The story of pop superstar Michael Jackson, from his extraordinary early days in the Jackson 5 to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

programme.title: The Exorcist: Believer
programme.desc: When his daughter, Angela, and her friend, Katherine, show signs of demonic possession, it unleashes a chain of events that forces single father Victor Fielding to confront the nadir of evil.

programme.title: The Girl Who Cried Pearls
programme.desc: In Montreal, at the dawn of the 20th century, a poor boy falls in love with a girl whose sorrow turns into pearls. He sells them to a ruthless pawnbroker, who hungers for more. Tempted by greed, the boy must choose between love and fortune.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Hank wants to change methods; Wanda uncovers a shocking truth about founding pioneer woman Jane T. Wright; Oscar tries to sneak into the fair despite being banned.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Brent, Hank and Emma have a viral video contest; Karen and Davis try to GPS tag the locals; Lacey asks Wanda to secure her Wi-Fi.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash draws on his war zone experience when extreme weather causes the hospital to lose power.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Novel Murders
programme.desc: Antiques expert Jennifer Shannon believes two items found at the scene of a murder are actually clues straight out of famous mystery stories.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Art of Murder
programme.desc: Jennifer finds a body in the attic of a local residence, and when she learns that the victim was trying to call 911, she begins to suspect foul play.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Match
programme.desc: Princess Camille travels to America to create a college exchange program and falls for Professor Rhett.

programme.title: Amish Affair
programme.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Triumph: Rock & Roll Machine
programme.desc: The story of underdog Canadian rock band Triumph, which rose to stardom in the 1970s and '80s only to disappear at the height of its fame.

programme.title: Bookworm
programme.desc: Mildred's life is turned upside down when her mother lands in hospital and his father, Strawn Wise, comes to look after her. Strawn takes Mildred camping in the rugged New Zealand wilderness and the pair embark on the ultimate test of family bonding.

programme.title: Brian and Charles
programme.desc: Brian is a lonely and unlucky inventor who takes on his most ambitious project yet -- an artificial intelligence robot made from odds and ends, including an old washing machine.

programme.title: A View to a Kill
programme.desc: British secret agent James Bond ties a mad tycoon and his statuesque aide to a plot to flood Silicon Valley.

programme.title: Predator: Badlands
programme.desc: Cast out from its clan, an alien hunter and an unlikely ally embark on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

programme.title: Sniper: The Last Stand
programme.desc: On a mission to stop an arms dealer from unleashing a deadly weapon, ace sniper Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a group of elite soldiers against an unrelenting militia in Costa Verde.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

programme.title: Modern Whore
programme.desc: Andrea Werhun portrays her past roles as escort Mary Ann, stripper Sophia, and her OnlyFans presence, all part of her Toronto sex work journey.

programme.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Kitties: The Bubbles and the S...rockers Story
programme.desc: A viral clip earns Bubbles and his band a spot on a European tour, opening for Billy Bob Thornton and the Boxmasters. With Randy as their trusty roadie, the group heads to Prague, only to find themselves kicked off the tour and busking to survive.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Wanda goes power mad; Davis and Karen make a dangerous bet; Oscar recalls "the incident" that made him give up the game for good; Brent and Hank are lost in the woods.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Wanda creates her dream video game; Lacey and Karen offer to help Davis release his pent-up stress; Oscar and Emma break out the crokinole board.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: As shakeups force major turmoil at the hospital, Bash and Amira take a trip.

programme.title: Air Bud
programme.desc: Abandoned by a disagreeable clown (Michael Jeter), a golden retriever with a knack for basketball befriends a lonely boy (Kevin Zegers).

programme.title: Dark Side of the 2000s
programme.desc: Radio king Howard Stern continues to draw attention with his on-air antics; when Opie and Anthony resurface, their hatred for Howard isn't enough to save the toxic friendship.

programme.title: Moonraker

programme.title: Chasse pêche TV
programme.desc: À travers les tournages de chasse et de pêche depuis les 27 dernières années, Norman Byrns et son équipe, des passionnés de chasse et pêche, partagent leurs expériences, et leur mission de respecter la nature et de conserver l'héritage de la faune.

programme.title: Les aventures de l'équipe Roadfish
programme.desc: On combine des fanatiques de pêche à une équipe de réalisation vidéo pour donner des images attrayantes et vraies; le but est de découvrir des coins de pêche inusités, connaître les gens et leurs histoires, les places où il faut manger et dormir.

programme.title: Bête de chasse
programme.desc: Pour divertir les passionnés de chasse, on présente des vidéos à sensations fortes, des capsules, des conseils techniques et des gens qui pratiquent cette passion.

programme.title: Roadhunt: chasse et aventures
programme.desc: Des chasseurs, hommes, femmes et enfants parcourent le territoire à la recherche des plus beaux endroits pour pratiquer la chasse ; on expose les expériences et le mode de vie des chasseurs sportifs à la recherche du plaisir et de l'aventure !

programme.title: Gem & Shaz
programme.desc: Two Asian Canadian teenage girls are given one hour at the school dance by their strict immigrant parents and are determined to make the most of it.

programme.title: To the Arctic
programme.desc: With ice melting in their Arctic environment, a polar bear and her two cubs do what they can to adapt and survive.

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Residents of a small fishing community in Newfoundland charm a doctor into becoming the town's full-time physician in order to secure a vital factory contract.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula builds the Monster Hotel to raise his daughter Mavis safely away from humans. Dracula tries to stop her from leaving, but during Mavis's 118th birthday party, an uninvited human named Johnny appears.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A magic portal transports the little blue people to Manhattan, where they must find a way back to their village before evil wizard Gargamel can find them.

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: Papa and the rest of the Smurfs reunite with their human friends to rescue Smurfette from the clutches of evil wizard Gargamel.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: With the evil wizard Gargamel (Rainn Wilson) hot on their trail, Smurfette (Demi Lovato), Brainy (Danny Pudi), Clumsy (Jack McBrayer) and Hefty (Joe Manganiello) embark on a journey through the Forbidden Forest to find a mysterious village.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

programme.title: The Meg
programme.desc: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat—a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

programme.title: Killer Whale
programme.desc: Best friends Maddie and Trish embark on a spectacular adventure to a private lagoon halfway across the world. However, their peaceful retreat soon becomes a terrifying fight for survival when a killer whale seeks vengeance for a life in captivity.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A New York paleontologist (Bridget Fonda) goes to the backwoods of Maine and teams up with the local game warden (Bill Pullman) to stop a 35-foot killer crocodile.

programme.title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
programme.desc: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.

programme.title: Heavenly Bodies
programme.desc: Samantha quits her job to open an aerobics studio and competes with a larger club's lead instructor to become an aerobics instructor on a local fitness television show.

programme.title: Being Canadian
programme.desc: Rob Cohen tries to find out what it really means to be Canadian.

programme.title: Don't You Forget About Me
programme.desc: Four filmmakers travel to Illinois to find filmmaker John Hughes.

programme.title: Goose!
programme.desc: A boy (Max Morrow) conspires to save a talking gander from a man (Chevy Chase) who plans to cook the bird in an upcoming culinary contest.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: An upper-class lawyer (Daniel Day-Lewis) falls in love with his fiancée's (Winona Ryder) freethinking cousin (Michelle Pfeiffer) in the 1870s New York.

programme.title: A Beautiful Mind
programme.desc: Mathematics expert John Forbes Nash Jr. has paranoid schizophrenia but becomes a Nobel laureate late in life.

programme.title: The Imitation Game
programme.desc: Genius British logician and cryptologist Alan Turing (Benedict Cumberbatch) helps crack Germany's Enigma Code during World War II but is later prosecuted by his government for illegal homosexual acts.

programme.title: The Prestige
programme.desc: After an illusion goes tragically wrong, two 19th-century magicians (Hugh Jackman, Christian Bale) engage in a bitter and potentially deadly rivalry.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.

programme.title: Fightland
programme.desc: After spending eight years in a U.S. prison, boxing champion Duke Kilroy returns home seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up -- criminal kingpin, and his former promoter, Kingsley Marshall.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: An unlicensed boxing promoter gets involved with a big-time criminal, and a heist goes awry when a valuable jewel is missing.

programme.title: This Is the End
programme.desc: Cabin fever and dwindling supplies threaten to tear apart six friends who are trapped in a house together after cataclysmic events devastate Los Angeles.

programme.title: Nelly & Simon: Mission Yeti
programme.desc: A private eye and a university research assistant search for the abominable snowman in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Manufactured Landscapes
programme.desc: The work of photographer Edward Burtynsky includes China's ongoing Industrial Revolution.

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a mating pair of abnormals is brought in for scientific study, the team begins to exhibit attractions for each other.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus travels to Rome to lead a covert meeting on abnormals; the Cabal seeks revenge for the release of the three witches from Scotland.

programme.title: Kayak to Klemtu
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl readies for a kayak trip along the shores of the Great Bear rainforest with her family to protest oil tanker traffic.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.

programme.title: The Iron Giant
programme.desc: A malevolent government agent threatens to destroy the friendship between a boy and a huge alien robot.

programme.title: Cairo Time
programme.desc: During a vacation in Egypt, an unexpected love affair arises between a magazine editor (Patricia Clarkson) and her husband's former colleague (Alexander Siddig).

programme.title: The War With Grandpa
programme.desc: Forced to give up his room to his grandfather, a scheming boy devises a series of outrageous pranks in an attempt to make him move out.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actual witch (Nicole Kidman) and a neurotic movie star (Will Ferrell) land the lead roles in a television remake of the 1960s sitcom.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: A teen (Christina Ricci) who lost her mother befriends friendly ghost Casper while staying at a mean heiress's (Cathy Moriarty) haunted mansion.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two pinheads (Mira Sorvino, Lisa Kudrow) try to impress former classmates with far-fetched success stories.

programme.title: 17 Again
programme.desc: A 37-year-old gets the chance to correct the mistakes of his past when he is miraculously transformed into a teenager (Zac Efron).

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: Catherine of Aragon arrives in England to wed Prince Arthur, heir to the English throne, in a marriage contract intended to forge an alliance between the two nations.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: Catherine is one step closer to the English throne with her marriage to Arthur, but must navigate the challenges of a new relationship and a new court.

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A man (Gordon Pinsent) becomes confused and angry when his wife (Julie Christie), an Alzheimer's patient, seems to prefer the company of another resident at her nursing home.

programme.title: Tom at the Farm
programme.desc: A young man (Xavier Dolan) travels to an isolated farm for his lover's funeral where he's quickly drawn into a twisted, sexually charged game by his lover's aggressive brother (Pierre-Yves Cardinal).

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: A young artist with the ability to draw detailed pictures from memory may be the key to solving a case surrounding the suspicious death of his abusive father.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus and Will investigate a distressing call for help deep below the Bermuda Triangle resulting in a deadly battle to save Magnus's life.

programme.title: Percy
programme.desc: Third-generation farmer Percy Schmeiser joins forces with up-and-coming attorney Jackson Weaver and environmental activist Rebecca Salcau to fight a monumental legal battle against a corporate giant.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: A harried patriarch (Steve Martin) faces separation anxiety, exorbitant costs and more as he prepares for his daughter's (Kimberly Williams) wedding.

programme.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programme.desc: A dog that plays volleyball helps investigators solve a rash of mysterious crimes.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: A group of high-school students, who are infused with unique superpowers, harness their abilities in order to save the world.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Jack Lengyel, the new coach at West Virginia's Marshall University, vows to rebuild the school's football program after a plane crash claims the lives of 75 players, staff and fans.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Two cops must confront their teenage angst all over again when they go undercover as high-school students.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Officers Jenko and Schmidt begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: Catherine remains determined to become England's future Queen and makes plans to marry Prince Harry; Lizzie has a troubling premonition following a complicated labor.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: As the nation mourns Lizzie's passing and Catherine works to secure her marriage to Harry, Henry shocks the family by announcing his intention to honor his wife's dying wish.

programme.title: How She Move
programme.desc: Forced to return to public school after her sister's death, a young dancer (Rutina Wesley) has a rivalry with a classmate (Tré Armstrong) and joins an all-male dance troupe.

programme.title: Giant Little Ones

programme.desc: Léo découvre s'il y a déjà eu des dinosaures au Québec; la nouvelle collaboratrice Jade Lachine apprend pourquoi la sauce piquante brûle la bouche, et Luka et Léo sont mis au défi de réussir à faire un salto arrière.

programme.title: Au coeur du port
programme.desc: Les travaux d'agrandissement à Contrecœur débutent doucement. À Bécancour, nous embarquons sur un navire de NEAS en route vers l'Arctique, suivons le déchargement à Kuujjuaq, puis revenons à Montréal pour la dernière opération de dragage de l'année.

programme.title: Donner l'goût
programme.desc: On rencontre Madame Kim, cheffe propriétaire du restaurant Parfum de Corée, dont la renommée n'est plus à faire à Rimouski. On cuisine des plats savoureux et réconfortants. On découvre la K-Pop et on démystifie les deux Corées.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On met au défi les équipes de faire tomber une fléchette directement dans le goulot d'une bouteille, on s'intéresse aux différents types de taches sur les vêtements et aux moyens de les chasser et notre Boîte contient un équipement de sécurité.

programme.title: La langue dans ma poche
programme.desc: France D'Amour nous révèle l'objet étonnant qui lui a déjà servi de lit en tournée; les équipes cherchent à avoir le dernier mot dans des textos; il y a des fautes à revendre dans les petites annonces en ligne; les équipes les trouveront-elles?

programme.title: Une époque formidable
programme.desc: On reçoit l'écrivain Maxime Blanchard pour discuter de son livre controversé, on parle de l'hypertrucage qui devient un outil puissant pour les fraudeurs, et on s'instruit sur la cryptomonnaie, investissement populaire chez les millénariaux.

programme.title: Titanic en couleur : les nouvelles images
programme.desc: Le premier épisode explore la construction du Titanic et des témoignages de passagers; des films restaurés et colorisés dévoilent le navire, sa diversité et ses intérieurs luxueux, offrant un aperçu unique de la vie à bord avant le naufrage.

programme.title: Moi j'mange
programme.desc: Retour en classe pour apprendre l'ABC de la béchamel végane, des pâtes fraîches et du pesto; Bernard offre des astuces pour détecter les fausses informations en nutrition; Evelyne présente des applications pour économiser à l'épicerie.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On présente une machine à calculer vieille de plusieurs siècles, on explore les propriétés chimiques d'un médicament contre les maux d'estomac, le lait de magnésie, et on se demande si la musique peut influencer le goût du fromage.

programme.title: Arkeo
programme.desc: Pendant des milliers d'années, des hommes ont réalisé sur ces parois pas moins de 35 000 peintures rupestres ; des archéologues ont enfin réussi à les décoder.

programme.title: Cochon dingue
programme.desc: On reçoit la comédienne Virginie Ranger-Beauregard pour explorer le thème de l'échelle; Capitaine Jeux de mots porte secours à une plongeuse incapable de monter l'échelle du tremplin et l'on discute du livre "Colle-moi" au club de lecture.

programme.title: L'île Kilucru
programme.desc: Milo veut aménager un jardin pour Dalia avec de vieilles semences ayant appartenu à Trollilo; pour le troll, il est hors de question de tolérer un autre jardin sur l'île; inspirée par un de ses livres, Zora se déguise en justicière.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: Malgré le désir de Rachel que les quatre éléments restent unis, les enfants se séparent. Rachel et Juliette vont voir le Dafiranda, qui les met en garde contre un dangereux cactus.

programme.title: Léon, (t)erreur de la savane
programme.desc: Léon et une hyène moqueuse se disputent un gigot resté sur la broche d'un bivouac abandonné.

programme.title: Luka et Léo
programme.desc: Léo apprend l'art de rapper vite avec KJT; les animateurs s'affrontent au minigolf; on se demande qui est le meilleur joueur de soccer au monde: Messi ou Ronaldo; pourquoi les tartines semblent toujours tomber sur leur côté beurré.

programme.title: Rouge forêt
programme.desc: Les ravisseurs exigent une rançon pour libérer Charlotte et Éloi ; Zoé, dépassée par la situation, hésite, tandis que Mathilde et Billi agissent dans son dos ; Florence plonge dans le désespoir quand elle apprend que la plante miracle n'existait pas.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: Un professionnel montre comment on aiguise des couteaux de cuisine, on fait tomber une boîte d'allumettes en espérant qu'elle reste debout et on essaie de deviner quel outil se cache dans la Boîte.

programme.title: Kebec
programme.desc: Deux guerres ont eu des répercussions surprenantes dans l'histoire du Québec : la guerre d'Indépendance américaine et la guerre froide.

programme.title: Titanic en couleur : les nouvelles images
programme.desc: On commence avec une vente aux enchères d'objets du Titanic; on suit le dernier jour du Titanic, avec des témoignages de passagers et des images restaurées; le naufrage est raconté par des animations et des récits de survivants.

programme.title: 4 saisons au royaume du panda
programme.desc: Le quotidien de deux familles de pandas, de la naissance à l'âge adulte; au plus près, l'ursidé noir et blanc se révèle comme jamais auparavant, dans son intimité la plus totale.

programme.title: Coeurs noirs
programme.desc: Tandis que la DGSE monte un plan pour détourner l'attention de Moktar, le groupe 45 passe à l'attaque pour exfiltrer Sab.

programme.title: L'obsession fatale d'Hitler
programme.desc: Après un hiver terrible, 1942 commence mal pour Staline en raison d'une campagne nazie impitoyable qui laisse des millions de Soviétiques captifs et sans nourriture.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: Un professionnel montre comment on aiguise des couteaux de cuisine, on fait tomber une boîte d'allumettes en espérant qu'elle reste debout et on essaie de deviner quel outil se cache dans la Boîte.

programme.title: Kebec
programme.desc: Deux guerres ont eu des répercussions surprenantes dans l'histoire du Québec : la guerre d'Indépendance américaine et la guerre froide.

programme.title: Tout est parfait
programme.desc: Un adolescent de 17 ans découvre que ses quatre meilleurs amis se sont suicidés à la suite d'un pacte dont il est exclu.

programme.title: Titanic en couleur : les nouvelles images
programme.desc: On commence avec une vente aux enchères d'objets du Titanic; on suit le dernier jour du Titanic, avec des témoignages de passagers et des images restaurées; le naufrage est raconté par des animations et des récits de survivants.

programme.title: Les anonymes
programme.desc: Le PEM entraîne une nouvelle cuvée d'élèves dotés de superpouvoirs; une tempête épique se profile à l'horizon et les jumeaux préparent une mission de secours élaborée.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Alors que la maison des Bouviers est mise en vente, Bluey en est très contrariée.

programme.title: Les petites histoires de Bluey
programme.desc: Papa se rend au salon de tatouage où ses filles travaillent. Il veut un tatouage qui fasse peur, avec des crânes ou des serpents. Mais lorsque vient le moment de découvrir le résultat, il a une énorme surprise.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Cette série, destinée aux enfants, met en scène les aventures de Barbapapa.

programme.title: BooSnoo!
programme.desc: BooSnoo se lance dans l'espace, voyage autour d'une planète et traverse ensuite un trou noir!

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille
programme.desc: Harold a des superpouvoirs grâce à un morceau de météorite ; lorsqu'il menace de transformer la Grande Vallée en île, la Super Patrouille intervient.

programme.title: Mumfie
programme.desc: Babou a décidé d'organiser une veillée tard ; pour être certaine que tout le monde soit en forme, elle conseille à chacun de faire une sieste ; oui, mais voilà, c'est compliqué de s'endormir sur commande.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon et Gaspard jouent dans le jardin, mais le ciel menaçant incite Maman à les faire rentrer à la maison; l'orage éclate; Maman a beau dire à Gaspard que dans la maison il n'y a rien à craindre, il n'est vraiment pas rassuré.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing et ses amis réparent un cerf-volant pour qu'il puisse voler très haut.

programme.title: Tulipop
programme.desc: Les aventures d'un groupe d'amis colorés sur l'île magique de Tulipop.

programme.title: Patamuse
programme.desc: Tao le panda prête son tapis volant à Gus le mouton ; pendant ce temps, Tao part faire sa sieste.
